artifact_observations.reasoning: There is text on a box or screen in the blurry background. It is illegible and distorted, typical of AI generation struggling with small, out-of-focus text, though it does not affect the main subject.

The text on the click wheel ('MENU', 'NEXT', etc.) is extremely faint and lacks the crisp embossing or printing seen on real devices. It looks slightly 'melted' into the plastic rather than printed on it.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation (Classic vs Nano vs Shuffle) and ensure it matches the visual features of a genuine iPod.
To closely inspect the click wheel text legibility and surface reflections for subtle AI artifacts like smearing or inconsistent lighting.
To verify the depth of field blur is physically consistent with the camera angle and focal length implied by the sharpness of the foreground.
To analyze the gibberish text in the background to determine if it's a severe artifact or just standard bokeh distortion.

focus_areas: Legibility and physical plausibility of click wheel labels
Consistency of reflections on the white plastic casing
Edge sharpness between the click wheel and the body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the click wheel text. In many AI-generated iPods, the words 'MENU', 'PLAY/PAUSE', etc., are garbled or missing. Also, check if the screen reflection matches the environment. The background text is blurry but should not look like alien symbols if it's meant to be English packaging.
